issues.description: The problem statement/UML requires a parameterless method "getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int". However, the solution implements "getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests): int" instead. This signature mismatch means a student implementation following the statement will not match the solution API/tests, and dependent methods in the solution also call the boolean overload.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to implement exactly "public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()" (no parameters) returning "numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents". Update "getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents()" and "getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()" to call the parameterless method. If excluding guests is desired, introduce a separate clearly named method rather than changing the required signature.
